question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

An amount of money that is paid at one time
solution:
The correct answer is: **Lump sum**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The one-word substitute for the given group of words is "**Lump sum**."
 
• "**An amount of money**" can be condensed into a single term "**Lump**."
 
• "**That is paid at one time**" can be summarized as "**sum**."
 
• Therefore, "**Lump sum**" effectively represents the concept of an amount of money paid at one time.
 
• It's a common term used in financial contexts to refer to a single, large payment made at once, rather than in instalments or over time.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Advanced amount**: A sum of money that is paid or provided in advance before it is due or before work has been completed.
 
• **Credit**: The ability of a person or entity to borrow money with the understanding that it will be repaid at a later date.
 
• **Mortgage**: A loan that is taken out to purchase real estate, typically a home.
